title: AE for Monroe Skykomish Riverfront Park Restoration
short_description: A/E services for riverfront park restoration, fish passage, floodplain connectivity, design, permitting, and construction management.

services: Architecture and engineering services including conceptual design, feasibility/preliminary design, final design, permitting assistance, and construction management.

- No bridge, building, roof, tower, stadium, or special structural scope is described.
